name: sancho-fetch
description: Ask Claude for public data; Sancho fetches it into real files on your computer.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to your local Sancho Fetch library. Requires Sancho to be installed first: open your sancho-fetch folder in an AI app and paste 'Set up Sancho on this computer', or double-click the installer in the folder's installers/ directory. No settings needed here -- Sancho finds your registered library on its own.
